title: In 1937, Pittsburgh built a 102-foot water tank that doubled as a park lookout
summary_full: The historic North Park Observation Tower in Pittsburgh is poised to reopen its doors after being closed for years. A comprehensive restoration effort is underway, focusing on the beloved 1937 building and its staircase, while also enhancing the surrounding park area with fresh landscaping and improved accessibility. Funded by a mix of public and private investments, the landmark is anticipated to welcome guests once more by 2027.
